title: Engeletin attenuates the inflammatory response via inhibiting TLR4-NFkappaB signaling pathway in Crohn's disease-like colitis.
authors: Wei, Ziyun; Ni, Xiao; Cui, He; Shu, Chang; Peng, Yuxuan; Liu, Jieyu; Li, Yunwei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Engeletin通过TLR4-NFkappaB信号通路缓解克罗恩病样结肠炎炎症，仅涉及分子对接且对象为蛋白-小分子，非蛋白质-DNA互作，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Smilax glabra rhizome has a long history been used for clinical purposes in traditional Chinese medicinal for treating various inflammatory conditions. Engeletin(1) (ENG) is one of the most abundant bioactive compounds found in Smilax glabra rhizome, with anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and ulcer-preventing activities. AIM OF THE STUDY: The purpose of this study was to investigate the ability of ENG to alleviate inflammatory symptoms and improve epithelial barrier integrity utilize a 2,4,6-trinitrobenzene sulfonic acid(2) (TNBS)-induced murine model in Crohn's disease(3) (CD)-like colitis, and to characterize the underlying anti-inflammatory mechanisms of action. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A colitis model was established in BALB/c mice and treated with ENG for 7 days. RAW264.7 macrophages were pre-treated with ENG and lipopolysaccharide(4) (LPS) stimulation. The mice's weight and colon length were assessed. qPCR and Western blotting were used to analyze gene expression and TLR4-NFkappaB pathway. Flow cytometry was used to analyze the polarization states of the macrophages. RESULTS: Treatment with ENG was sufficient to significantly alleviate symptoms of inflammation and colonic epithelial barrier integrity in treated mice. Significant inhibition of TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, and IL-6 expression was observed following ENG treatment in vivo and in vitro. ENG was also determined to be capable of inhibiting the expression of iNOS and CD86, inhibited M1 macrophage polarization in vitro, as well as the TLR4-NFkappaB signaling pathway. Molecular docking showed a highly stable binding between ENG and TLR4. CONCLUSION: ENG has been proven to alleviate inflammation and ameliorate the damage of epithelial barrier in CD-like colitis. ENG also suppressed the M1 macrophages polarization and the inhibited inflammatory cytokines. TLR4-NFkappaB signaling pathway, especially TLR4, may be the target of ENG. These data offer a new insight into the therapeutic mechanisms of ENG.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：菝葜（Smilax glabra）根茎在传统中药中有着悠久的临床应用历史，用于治疗多种炎症性疾病。恩格列汀（Engeletin, ENG）是菝葜根茎中含量最丰富的生物活性化合物之一，具有抗炎、抗氧化和抗溃疡活性。研究目的：本研究旨在利用2,4,6-三硝基苯磺酸（TNBS）诱导的克罗恩病（CD）样结肠炎小鼠模型，探讨ENG缓解炎症症状和改善上皮屏障完整性的能力，并阐明其潜在的抗炎作用机制。材料与方法：在BALB/c小鼠中建立结肠炎模型，并用ENG处理7天。RAW264.7巨噬细胞预先用ENG处理，然后进行脂多糖（LPS）刺激。评估小鼠体重和结肠长度。使用qPCR和Western blotting分析基因表达及TLR4-NFkappaB通路。使用流式细胞术分析巨噬细胞的极化状态。结果：ENG处理足以显著缓解处理小鼠的炎症症状和结肠上皮屏障完整性损伤。在体内和体外，ENG处理后观察到TNF-α、IL-1β和IL-6表达的显著抑制。ENG还被确定能够抑制iNOS和CD86的表达，在体外抑制M1巨噬细胞极化，以及TLR4-NFkappaB信号通路。分子对接显示ENG与TLR4之间具有高度稳定的结合。结论：ENG已被证明能够缓解CD样结肠炎中的炎症并改善上皮屏障损伤。ENG还抑制了M1巨噬细胞极化并抑制炎症细胞因子。TLR4-NFkappaB信号通路，特别是TLR4，可能是ENG的作用靶点。这些数据为ENG的治疗机制提供了新的见解。
